title: Roadmark bus integration boundaries
scope: Read-only integration preparation using supplied local evidence and current application schema. No app/data edits, network research, contacts, orders or new approval checks. Output is a review recommendation, not an executable catalogue overlay.

summary.countMeaning: Seven explicit current sales-sheet/listed configuration scopes. Adding the optional Fleetmaster derivative would produce eight detail rows across seven admitted base families, not eight newly discovered market families or eight open-order trims.

admit: Current Australian manufacturer/distributor commercial listing plus a model-matched sales specification for an explicit body/layout or tightly labelled complete-bus specification envelope.
Keep unidentified options, technical conflicts and unsupported commercial facts as holds; an incomplete field does not by itself invalidate the current listing.
For Mini, source identity is limited to the sales sheet. Its standard layout is current-listed; the linked manual cannot establish exact powertrain/capacity.
auditOnly: A current aftersales/procurement document does not establish that its technical code is the current sold build when the commercial page is not matched and has materially different specifications.
Do not convert a current family listing, source validation pass, or document link into exact trim/orderability proof.
decisionTest.whyNotEight: BRS8 has excellent bounded technical evidence but lacks a matched current commercial configuration. The source package recommendation describes technical/listing records and does not itself close that gap.
decisionTest.conditionalFallback: If Roadmark cannot display the explicit sales-sheet scope, null fields and unresolved conditions, keep Mini and any other insufficiently labelled record in family audit/search rather than relaxing this boundary.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Use existing Variant fields with snake_case, additions.facts rows keyed by variantId, and Fact statuses from the union. Evidence package statuses verified/conflicting/unknown are not valid application Status values.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Map verified scoped source declarations to conditional, unknown/conflicting normalized values to not_verified with null, options to optional. Preserve original source status and raw text in research provenance.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: current_or_order_listed is displayed as Current manufacturer listing, not orders open.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Admitted rows can use current_or_order_listed plus availability_evidence.orderStatus=listed_unconfirmed. Do not set accepting_orders.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Shared stock-status validation recognizes new_stock_listed, no_new_stock_verified and unverified; supplier_stock_claim is not an accepted correction enum.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Use stockStatus=unverified and preserve D7E/C12E generic stock assertions in sourced qualifications/claim facts. No row qualifies for new_stock_listed on this evidence.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Variant unknown extension fields are not automatically copied into the typed Car. Car has no rankingEligible property.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Do not rely on copying rankingEligible:false. Use vehicle_class=bus and conditional/not_verified comparison facts; verify runtime ranking exclusions.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Rank admission requires numeric Fact.value, standard status, basis, fresh sources and no issues; vehicleClass only separates buckets.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: All proposed bus comparison facts must remain conditional or not_verified. A bus class prevents cross-class grouping but is not a no-ranking flag.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Generic seats means occupied seating positions; mapping driver-exclusive passenger seats would change semantics.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Keep generic Variant.seats and facts.seats null. Use labelled seated_passengers, standing_passengers, driver_seats and wheelchair_positions with layout qualifiers. Do not compute passenger totals.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Detail page calls every row an Australian variant record and renders trim plus generic seating visualization.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Safe trim must explicitly say listed layout or dated sales sheet. A broad model family or BRS8 technical reference does not belong in this detail slot without an appropriate record-type UI.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Empty generated facts may lose source/hold context before additions.facts overlays are applied.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Provide explicit additions.facts null overlays with qualifications and source citations for every held important field; do not rely only on Variant.notes.

applicationSchemaFindings.finding: Adding a Variant creates unknown default feature rows and software history placeholders.
applicationSchemaFindings.action: Only populate exact visible equipment evidence. Do not treat Yutong five-year Link+ inclusion as lifetime free service, a counted OTA event or generic smartphone-app capability.

sharedNonNegotiableHolds: No inferred manufacturer model year from July 2026/February 2025 document dates, retrieval date, URL folder or revision suffix.

Yutong visible rendered pages govern. Hidden superseded layers and filename revision letters do not establish current safety/layout equipment. D7E URL C/footer D; C12E and E12 URL G/footer D remain recorded conflicts.

Do not rename 750 V as 750 kW, infer charge power from volts times amps, infer charge time from battery divided by power, infer range from energy divided by consumption, or infer finished payload from GVM minus kerb.
Do not reinterpret 434 / 399 kWh as gross/usable or two trims, CATL 422 kW as kWh, or 105 kW/hr as verified kWh.
Seat layouts, child/flex school capacity, wheelchair occupancy, doors, battery choices, body suppliers and upholstery must never generate a Cartesian-product trim set.
Only a complete bus counts as a road vehicle. Chassis plus body is one relationship, and a body-platform entry is not a second vehicle.
GVM declarations, ADR 68 seating, DDA claims and TfNSW panel/category marketing are not independent national or state-permitted operating-mass/registration verification.
Panel battery warranty says 85 months, 7.5 years and seven years/five months alongside 800000 km. Preserve the contradiction and procurement scope; do not create a clean retail warranty promise.
No disclosed source validation result establishes supplier truth, real-world range, physical stock, legal approval, current order acceptance or exhaustive market coverage.

Before any later integration, reconcile existing family records instead of adding duplicate family counts, and separately count listed configurations, named derivatives, audit-only technical references and verified stock units.
